card.name: The word intellectual before property
card.fires_on: The word "intellectual" (or its split-up form "Intel|lectual") when it begins the phrase "intellectual property", in legal, patent and trade-agreement text.

modes.label: Intellectual before property
modes.description: The word "intellectual" appears just before "property", "property rights" or "IP" in legal or technical writing.
modes.example: Patents are the part of the<< intellectual>> property law that protects inventions.

card.writes: It strongly promotes the word "property" as the next word.
card.plain: It spots the word "intellectual" when "property" is about to follow, as in "intellectual property" rights and law.
